restoration_note: This teaching traces the self's fivefold generation (kinds 1-5: trees, painted productions, third generation, bitter fruits, worlds of flesh) culminating in twelve spirits of error against the First Man. The skeleton of the text is well-anchored: the standard catalogue of five dark elements (smoke/fire/wind/water/darkness), the gendered male-female mingling, the pneuma-sōma pair of darkness's body, and the twelve-zodia opposition all give firm Coptic constraints, allowing high-confidence restorations of editor-proposed letter completions and several content fills (e.g. ⲥⲱⲙⲁ at gap 38 as the obligatory complement to ⲡⲛⲁ̄). The opening ⲙⲏⲉ ('truth') at gap 0 fits the coordinated divine-side genitives. Gap 45 is restored as ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲡ (King of Darkness), the structural opposite of First Man supplied by the lexicon. Sixteen gaps were left unrestorable: long content lacunae lacking parallel formulas (gaps 18, 20, 26, 28, 29, 36, 47, 50), the 30-char unreadable span at gap 46, and short particle/closing gaps without anchoring traces (3, 5, 6, 15, 23, 39, 41). Honest non-restoration was preferred over invention where the spiritual reading does not constrain the Coptic specifically.
